🎬 Rescued (2026)

Rescued follows Tyler, a homeless man struggling to survive the harsh realities of life on the streets while facing loneliness, uncertainty, and the daily challenges of finding safety and stability. With limited resources and few people to rely on, Tyler finds himself trapped in a difficult cycle of hardship that threatens his hope for a better future. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when a stray Doberman named Angel saves his life, creating an extraordinary connection that changes everything. Refusing to abandon Tyler, Angel becomes his loyal companion, offering unconditional love, protection, and a renewed sense of purpose. As their bond grows stronger, Tyler begins finding the motivation to confront his circumstances and work toward rebuilding his life. Together, they navigate the dangers of homelessness, difficult encounters, and the emotional challenges of surviving in a world where compassion can sometimes feel impossible to find. Through moments of struggle, kindness, sacrifice, and unexpected hope, Tyler discovers that even the smallest connection can inspire extraordinary personal transformation. Combining heartfelt drama, grounded storytelling, and an emotional portrayal of human resilience, the film explores homelessness, friendship, survival, compassion, second chances, and the remarkable healing power of the bond between humans and animals.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Independent Film
